name: Ultra Thin Cones 1 1/4"
description:
Zig-Zag paper cones are crafted from an ultra-thin paper to deliver a slow, even burn with zero hassle – just fill, pack and burn. Its crush-proof slide box fits easily in a pocket or purse, so you’re always ready for a smoke break. 
Pack - 6 Cones
